title: Volunteer Chaperone Checklist
subtitle: Capture trip assignment, student group, screening status, and supervision boundary; confirm emergency route and return handoff.
description: Volunteer Chaperone records trip assignment, student group, screening status, supervision boundary, emergency route, and return handoff. Volunteer Chaperone evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this volunteer chaperone stage-gated verification when staff must document trip assignment and student group. Reconcile screening status, supervision boundary, emergency route, and return handoff before the volunteer chaperone handoff. Use screening evidence, assignment roster, student-group list, supervision brief, emergency card route, transport seat list, checkpoint headcounts, and return handoff. This assignment places a screened adult with a student group using ratio and supervision boundaries, bus position, checkpoint headcounts, emergency response role, prohibited tasks, and return handoff. Ask the assigned volunteer chaperone reviewer to confirm trip assignment against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Volunteer Chaperone contact and reference
sections.guidance: Assign trip, student group, screening evidence, supervision boundary, transport position, emergency route, headcount responsibility, and return handoff.

sections.title: Volunteer Chaperone exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current volunteer chaperone facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Volunteer Chaperone required checks
items: Trip assignment is identified for this record
Student group matches the current request or source
Screening status is ready for point-of-use staff
Supervision boundary limits or questions are resolved
Emergency route is communicated to the responsible person
Return handoff is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Volunteer Chaperone readiness
sections.guidance: Hold volunteer chaperone readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.guidance: Volunteer Chaperone receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
